title: poecilopteris costata var. rubicunda
intro: Poecilopteris costata var. rubicunda, commonly known as the Red-stemmed Fern, is a type of plant species. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of the Red-stemmed Fern include its use as a diuretic and a bronchodilator, helping to relieve symptoms of bronchitis and other respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
